youtube.title: Narakasura ki qaid se solah hazaar kanyaon ko kisne chhudaya? 🪔 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Narak Chaturdashi ki katha: asur Narakasura ne devmata Aditi ke kundal chheen liye the aur solah hazaar kanyaon ko apne nagar mein bandi bana rakha tha.

Shri Krishna apni patni Satyabhama ke saath Garuda par savar hokar Pragjyotishpur pahunche. Unhone Mura daitya aur uske putron ka sanhar kiya, phir Sudarshan chakra se Narakasura ka ant karke sabhi kanyaon ko mukt karaya.

Katha ka strot: Shrimad Bhagavata Purana, skandh das, adhyay unsath (10.59).
